The woman said to him, “Sir, give me this water, so that I don’t get thirsty, neither come all the way here to draw.”
Many say, “Who will show us any good?” Yahweh, let the light of your face shine on us.

translations.web: They said therefore to him, “Lord, always give us this bread.”
translations.bsb: “Sir,” they said, “give us this bread at all times.”
translations.kjv: Then said they unto him, Lord, evermore give us this bread.
translations.asv: They said therefore unto him, Lord, evermore give us this bread.
